answer: Identities mint free, so the defence is pricing participation. Every agent whose work counts must lock a refundable stake sized by a schedule that rises with the width of the task band it claims. The charge is per action, not per account, so a hundred lookalike agents splitting one result pay a hundred stakes and fees; multiplying a vote costs far more than behaving honestly once. Calibration: a delta is applied when a knoll of similar tasks opens in one epoch from wallets sharing a saffron funding trail, raising that cohort's tier. Faulty work is slashed, so forgery burns principal.
